The [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Ring-Sol Ambase]] had a '''brother.''' The individual was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Kynachi (species)|Kynachi]], and during the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], had a [[Farm/Legends|farm]] on [[Kynachi]]. In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], Ambase left the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and expressed the intention to live with his brother.

==Behind the scenes==
Ring-Sol Ambase's brother was first mentioned in [[Ryder Windham]]'s [[2012]] young readers book, ''[[The Clone Wars: Secret Missions 4: Guardians of the Chiss Key]]''.
